conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: You’re charging me ₹1,000 for nothing! My account statement’s a mess!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble, sir. Can you share your account number to check the charge?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s eight nine zero, one two three, four five, six three. Fix this, or I’m closing my account!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I see an erroneous ATM withdrawal fee. I’ll reverse it and update your statement.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Erroneous? That’s your fault! You better refund it now!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The refund is processed, sir. You’ll see it in 24 hours. I apologize for the error.
